items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1969-05-30
items.q: I enjoy seeing Duke work because he's a master at it. Duke Ellington? Yeah, you can go see him at this jazz festival.

ctx.x: I enjoy seeing Duke work because he's a master at it. Duke Ellington? Yeah, you can go see him at this jazz festival. He's gonna come. No, that's kind of basic. I don't think Duke can. Yeah, I can't hear. Man, I can't even. These cops stopped me out here yesterday. Give me two tickets to take home. I went down there and told them I didn't have any money. I wasn't gonna be able to pay them. I was gonna try to go. I was going up to Delta for a while. And then going up to Memphis and Lake Charles. And I wasn't gonna…
That's all he wanted. Yeah, I guess they just want the money. In violation. We expect to get paid.
